name: badge
title: Badge
description: A set of compact pill labels in four fills, plus outlined versions carrying a tick, a coloured dot, a number or a link. Each is a single line of small medium-weight text on a full rounded background or border.
use: You need a compact inline label for status, counts or categories inside text or a list.
avoid: Labels are kept on one line with no wrapping, so a long tag will overflow instead of growing taller.
a11y: The pill is presentational text with no role; only the linked variant is focusable, and then it shows a visible ring. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rows of short pills on a black stage. The top row runs from a light filled pill through a dark grey and a bordered clear one to a pink-red one; the second row mixes outlined pills with a green tick, an amber dot, a white counter pill and a dark link pill.
behaves: Static: the clip only shows the pills sitting still. In the code a linked pill darkens slightly on hover, and keyboard focus adds a soft ring.
customise: The label is passed as children, the variant prop picks default, secondary, outline or destructive, and className overrides any style; asChild swaps the span for a link.
weight: light: A span with background and border classes; nothing runs or animates.
usage:
import { CheckIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"; export default function Demo() { return (
Default Secondary Outline Destructive
Verified Pending 12 Link badge
); }
